::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[How to delete a locally installed version of pgf?](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/5705/how-to-delete-a-locally-installed-version-of-pgf), asked by [Jan Hlavacek](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/396/jan-hlavacek) on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-11-20; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> I have a locally installed `pgf` in my local texmf tree.  Now my tex distribution finally caught up and the version of pfg in the package manager is newer than my locally installed version.  How can I delete the local version?
:::

This looks for all the subdirectories named `pgf` in the user's texmf directory, then deletes them.

```latex
find ${TEXMFHOME} -type d -name pgf | xargs rm -rf  
```

Use `rm -rf` with caution, of course!
